title: close silently leaves console descriptors open
description:
The syscall bridge reports a successful close without closing the descriptor, so defined C code produces a different result and an extra console effect (P0 wrong result/silent fallback).
Location: src/musl/syscall.c:72; the same source is included by src/native/syscall.c.
Input: close(1); errno=0; n=write(1,"X",1). Expected: n=-1, errno=EBADF, no output. Actual: n=1, console byte X; repeated close(1) also returns success. An independent native build of the same unmodified C source returns status 0/empty stdout, while the published checked runtime returns status 71/stdout X, on LLVM 18 and 23. The production bridge independently reproduces both cases with an effect recorder.
